angle: Geography-first local sources: county/city economic-development and chamber 'major employers'/'existing industry' pages, regional business press, and local newspaper/TV/public-radio coverage of trailer, chassis, axle, suspension and mobile-power plants in the trailer-building states; each lead resolved to a physical site and confirmed from a fetched page (local article, company page, or trade article).
notes: Stopped at the ~30-search cap, NOT at a dry point: the last batches (searches 21-29) still produced new plants (Cimarron, MAC Davis, Dorsey, Pitts, Hillsboro, Big Tex Cordele, Liberty Trailers). Searches were never refused. Fetches did not count against the cap. Blind spots: (1) the search engine mostly returned state economic-development releases, trade press (Trailer/Body Builders, Area Development) and job-board pages rather than county EDC or chamber pages, so 'local' coverage was thinner than intended; several leads were surfaced by state/trade results and are labelled in found_via; (2) many EDC/chamber employer pages are JS-rendered, members-only (Greater OKC Chamber) or bot-blocked (kingmanks.com, hoosierdata major-employers table), so their lists could not be read; (3) local news covers announcements and expansions, so plants with no recent news (small family shops, quiet long-running plants) are missed and many sources are 5-15 years old; (4) site-level product mix for multi-plant firms (Stoughton, MAC, Great Dane) is often only company-level; (5) Pacific Northwest, Florida, Michigan, North Carolina and Missouri produced almost nothing from local sources; (6) mobile-power and component plants (hitches, landing gear, axles) are under-covered. One job-posting-sourced row (Utility Enterprise AL) is flagged off-method. Rows with plant_confirmed=false are unconfirmed leads and should not count toward recall unless confirmed. After review, 37 rows are in-definition and plant-confirmed. Source class of those rows: trade press 9, local news 7, local 4, company site 4, site-selection trade press 4, state agency 2, regional business magazine 1, regional business press reprint of state agency release 1, job posting 1, regional business press 1, trade/real-estate press 1, federal 1, trade association news 1. Each row carries source_class. EDC/chamber retries (hoosierdata in browser, Yankton chamber category listing) returned no list.
